🤝 Import Direct Sales

➕ Record Offline Sale

Use this to log sales made directly by an author — e.g. book fairs, college events, personal sales.

📥 Bulk import (Excel / CSV)

Log a whole day's offline sales at once (book fairs, college events, personal sales — anything not already in MyBillBook). Download the template, fill one row per book sold, save as CSV, then upload it (or paste below). Every row is tagged to the author/account email below. Columns are auto-detected; fill the optional Ref column and already-imported refs are skipped on re-upload.

— or paste below

📋 Each entry is recorded in Odoo first (inventory + accounting), then the Sales-by-Author dashboard — nothing is saved to the dashboard unless Odoo accepts it. Since these sales aren't in MyBillBook, they're listed under Quick Reports → ⚠️ Not in MyBillBook so staff can back-enter them into MyBillBook while it's still your book of record.

🔄 Odoo Sync

Sync MyBillBook exports into Odoo. Run the local mbb_sync_prep.py on your 15-day export folder, then upload the generated odoo_sync_payload.json here.

Odoo reachable only while the cloudflared tunnel is up (ODOO_* env set).
No payload loaded.
This sync type isn't built yet — it'll reuse the same upload → batch-sync flow as Sale Orders.

🔁 Refresh Author Sales (Odoo → dashboards)

Pulls shop sales from Odoo for a period and (re)writes them into the Sales by Author / Total Sales dashboards, tagging each book to its author via Shopify submittedby: tags. Run this after an Odoo Sync so the dashboards reflect the latest data. (Re-runnable — replaces the period's Odoo-sourced rows; manual direct entries untouched.)

📄 Quick Reports

Live from Odoo (reachable while the tunnel is up). Pick a report, set the inputs, and Run.

↩️ Reconcile with MyBillBook

MyBillBook is the book of record. When staff cancel / return / refuse an order there, its invoice becomes ₹0 (Sales Invoice - Cancelled) and stock is restored — but Odoo still holds the original sale. Upload the latest daybook CSV; this finds invoices Odoo still counts as live and reverses them (credit note + stock return + refund) so Odoo matches MyBillBook. Nothing is deleted — the reversal is fully audited.

Odoo reachable only while the tunnel is up (ODOO_* env set).
Upload a MyBillBook daybook CSV.

💳 Razorpay → Odoo

Backfill historical subscription and Book Club charges into Odoo as GST invoices (both are taxable services, 18% GST — unlike books). New charges already invoice in real time; this closes the history. Idempotent — anything already in Odoo is skipped.

💰 Razorpay Payments

All captured Razorpay payments, split by type: Book Club, Author Subscriptions, and Book Purchases (native-app checkout & other).

Pick a range and click Load.

🏦 Razorpay Settlements

What Razorpay actually transferred to your bank. Payments are settled in batches (net of fees + GST), not order-by-order — each row is one bank credit with its UTR reference.

Pick a range and click Load.

Terms & Conditions

Last updated: May 2025

By subscribing to the Yellow Feather Books Book Club or Author's Plan, you agree to the following terms. Please read them carefully before proceeding.

1. Book Club Membership

  • The Book Club membership is available at ₹99 per year.
  • Benefits include discounts, surprise gifts, early access to new titles, high speed delivery, a member dashboard, and a newsletter.
  • Membership is non-transferable and valid for one account only.
  • Yellow Feather Books reserves the right to modify membership benefits with prior notice.
  • Refunds will not be provided for partially used membership periods.

2. Author's Plan Subscription

  • Author's Plans are available starting at ₹99 per month.
  • Plans include book listing, reach to readers, digital posters, Instagram collaboration, signed copy support, author dashboard, and online pre-launch.
  • Subscriptions are billed monthly and can be cancelled anytime before the next billing cycle.
  • Yellow Feather Books reserves the right to remove listings that violate content guidelines.
  • Listing approval is subject to review and is not guaranteed.

3. Payments

  • All payments are processed securely via Razorpay.
  • Prices are listed in Indian Rupees (INR) and are inclusive of applicable taxes.
  • Yellow Feather Books is not responsible for payment failures due to bank or network issues.

4. Privacy

  • Your personal information is used solely for providing services and will not be shared with third parties without consent.
  • We may send you newsletters and promotional emails. You can unsubscribe at any time.

5. Governing Law

These terms are governed by the laws of India. Any disputes shall be subject to the jurisdiction of courts in Kerala, India.

6. Contact

For any queries regarding these terms, please contact us at yellowfeatherpublications@gmail.com.
